title: CNF length bound by gate count
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs. The length of the CNF formula obtained from $C$ is at most four times the number of gates in $C$, plus one.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs
